title: Performance-Optimized Article
prompt: Mark up an article with dimensioned images, lazy-load an off-screen image, and explain which resource should load early.
objective: Add dimensions to both images and choose eager/priority versus lazy loading intentionally.
expected_output: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: resource priority, responsive images, loading.
hints: Do not lazy-load the main image likely visible at page start; use high priority only for a genuinely critical resource.
Review the connected lesson and make one focused revision at a time.
Run a validator or manually inspect the relevant browser behavior.

solution.answer:
Explore the Mountains

This primary image is visible immediately, so it is not lazy-loaded.

More from the trail

Additional images lower on the page can be loaded when they approach the viewport.
solution.explanation: One complete example is shown above. Reference approach: Do not lazy-load the main image likely visible at page start; use high priority only for a genuinely critical resource. Required structural evidence: width=, height=, loading="lazy", fetchpriority.
solution.expected_result: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: resource priority, responsive images, loading.

grading_method: server-side required-string smoke check plus human review for quality
retry_policy: Allow retries; only the first successful completion for this activity may award base XP. Incorrect submissions do not award XP.
